name: desk-t300-evo4
description: James's desk: Thrustmaster T300RS (belt), Audient EVO 4 -> Aura AST-2B shaker, an XInput pad. Every output names the renderer that serves it; the host instantiates exactly the outputs listed here.

sources.note: Shaker source gains, summed before the HP/LP and limiter: synth = Lfe.Synth (the bus), stems = Lfe.Stems (HD sound pack LFE stems). synth 0 = stems only, stems 0 = synth only. One run can override with I76_LFE_SOURCES=synth=0,stems=1.

lfe.hp_lp_note: 11/85 Hz are what ffb-lfe-live.ps1 / ffb-lfe-probe.ps1 ship (the LP corner is raised x1.35 inside LfeCore); HAPTICS-ARCHITECTURE's 'HP 22 / LP 90' describes intent, not the shipped constants
lfe.resp_source: ffb-lfe-sweep.ps1, 21 steps, perceived by body, n = 1 rater (2026-08)

stems.note: HD sound pack LFE stems (tools/soundhd, gitignored audio: run tools\soundhd\soundhd.py build). Played on SOUND_START, looped for modes 1/2 until the SOUND_STOP with the same voice; the player's own and 2D sounds at full level, others by distance. Mixed into the lfe output by lfe.sources.stems. No stems on disk = Lfe.Synth only.

motion.note: Plug-in point only. Motion cueing, washout and packet formats are a separate workstream: docs/MOTION-OUTPUT.md
